text:
Ana: Quick sync for Sundial private deploy - final blockers before Friday cutover. Need peering acceptance, KMS ARN confirmation, and short-lived bucket access for CloudTrail. Can we close these today?
Mike: I'll run networking checks. Do we have the confirmed VPC CIDR and the egress ranges they allow?
Ana: VPC CIDR = 10.40.0.0/16. Customer restricts egress to 10.0.0.0/8 + managed NAT for package updates. Also allow Redwood control plane egress IPs (listed in onboarding doc).
Jess: They asked for a single peering endpoint instead of multiple prefix lists. It's fine but they need firewall ACLs on their side. Any CIDR overlap flagged?
Mike: No overlap. Ran `scripts/cidr_check.sh 10.40.0.0/16 10.50.0.0/16` - clean. I'll prep the peering request and wait for their acceptance.
Sam: KMS Q: do they want a CMK in their account or a cross-account key we manage? Security prefers CMK in their account, with a key policy granting Redwood encrypt/decrypt role.
Ana: Yes, CMK in their account. Need the exact key ARN and whether they'll use it for CloudTrail + model artifact encryption. They asked for a minimal policy.
Sam: Proposed minimal key policy snippet for them to paste:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFOX_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-encrypt"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```Replace REDFOX_ACCOUNT with their account ID and role name. We'll need the exact ARN to finalize.
Jess: For audit logs: CloudTrail -> their central S3 bucket + CloudWatch -> SIEM subscription. Ask: do we get temporary read access to the bucket during onboarding or do they handle all triage?
Ana: Requesting 48h read-only access for `redwood-onboard` role to help debug any ingestion failures. We'll remove access after the window.
Mike: NAT note: they must open outbound to our control plane on 443 and 5222. I'll include a terraform route snippet after peering acceptance. Example I'll apply:```terraform
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "sundial_peering" {
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-50a1"
  vpc_id      = "vpc-40b1"
}
```Waiting on acceptance.
Sam: Rotation policy check: customer wants annual rotation. Our infra expects auto-rotate enabled; if they refuse, we'll wire alerts. They agreed to annual rotation and want alias prefix `sundial/`.
Ana: Customer message pasted to ticket: "Annual rotation OK, alias must be `sundial/` and CloudTrail encryption must use the same key."
Jess: SIEM details: logGroup names `/aws/usage/sundial-app` and `/aws/cloudtrail/sundial`. Need subscription filter config and TLS endpoint for their SIEM. They said TLS inspection is allowed.
Mike: Proposed cutover: Friday 18:00 UTC. That gives Monday rollback window. Any objections?
Sam: I can attach the minimal key policy once Ana confirms the ARN.
Ana: ARN added to doc: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321012:key/abcd-ef12-3456`. Sam, please add policy and I'll ask their IAM team to grant our role.
DeployBot: preflight check results: network=OK, kms=waiting_for_policy, cloudtrail_bucket=waiting_for_access. See https://deploys.redwood.ai/checks/3051236789
Mike: Holding terraform apply until DeployBot shows kms=OK.
Jess: I'll prepare the SIEM subscription filter and a short runbook for the 48h audit window.
Ana: Action items assigned: Mike -> apply peering & NAT after acceptance; Jess -> configure subscription filters and SIEM endpoint; Sam -> attach minimal key policy and confirm rotation; Ana -> request short-lived bucket read access and confirm cutover schedule with customer. We'll meet in #ops-bridge 1h before cutover.
Sam: Policy attached, left a least-privilege note in the onboarding doc.
Ana: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the ticket and ping ops-bridge before cutover.
Mike: Ready once peering acceptance shows up.
Jess: Runbook snippet added for audit support during the 48h window.
Ana: Closing this thread for now. Final sync in #ops-bridge 1h prior to cutover.
